newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-MIKE ROZIER WOUNDED IN SHOOTING.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-MIKE ROZIER WOUNDED IN SHOOTING.

text.p: Former Heisman Trophy winner and pro football running back Mike Rozier is recovering from gunshot wounds in his abdomen sustained in a predawn shooting, police said Wednesday.

Rozier and three or four other men were drinking on the sidewalk outside a Camden housing project an hour or so after midnight when a member of the party drew a pistol and opened fire, police said. The second man, Bert Merriel, 33, was more seriously injured.
The assailant was not fully identified, according to police Lieut. Joseph Richardson.
Rozier had returned to his native Camden, where he was a high school football star before going on to win the 1983 Heisman while attending the University of Nebraska.
He played in the U.S. Football League the next year before a five-year career with the NFL Houston Oilers. He ran for 3,426 yards, third on Houston's all-time rushing list.

Rozier was no stranger to trouble while in pro football. He faced a charge of weapons charge in Dickinson, Texas, in May 1990, when a gunshot came from a vehicle he was riding in. He also underwent alcohol counselling in 1987, while still on the Houston roster.
